title: AI for Your Work in 10 Days
description: A no-code course for working people: use free AI tools on your phone to finish reports, emails, documents and calculations faster, then turn your own Playbook into a working agent. It goes step by step, uses Nigerian examples throughout and assumes no technical knowledge. Days 1–7 put AI to work on your job; the three-day Agents Week turns your Playbook into an assistant with instructions, memory and a weekly routine.

modules.title: Week One: AI on Your Job
